lines.2: 「No need to be shy. I'm headed that way anyway.」
lines.3: 「Mana, can I talk to you a moment?」
lines.4: 「If you need the bathroom, go by yourself.」
lines.5: 「Th-That's not it. Just come with me.」
lines.6: Uraga is dragged away by Tonfa.
lines.7: All right, time for me to find Ms. Inori.
lines.8: 「Mana, Tsushima wants an excuse to return the key so he can talk to Ms. Inori. You really don't understand how men think?」
lines.9: 「Kah-kah-kah! You're reading way too much into it.」
lines.10: 「...And this is why people say you can't read the room...」
lines.12: 「Ms. Inori isn't in the faculty room...」
lines.16: The deep red sunset dyes everything around me.
lines.21: She is staring fixedly at it.
lines.23: Her expression carries a sorrow I could never imagine on her usual airy face.
lines.25: I find myself transfixed by her beautiful face.
lines.26: 「(What is she looking at so seriously...?)」
lines.27: Even though she's usually so frivolous.
lines.28: The angle makes it hard to see what Ms. Inori is looking at.
lines.29: If I stretch a little higher...
lines.30: Ah, now I can see it.
lines.32: A child? Is that a photograph of a little girl?
lines.35: Standing on tiptoe throws me off balance.
